identity.description: An attacker uses a signed Windows binary (like powershell.exe) to inject malicious code into a legitimate process, triggering the 'Globally uncommon injection from a signed process' alert. Cortex should detect the injection behavior and the anomalous process creation.

expected_artifacts.description: PowerShell process launching with hidden window

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Uncommon Injection from Signed Process
biocs.description: Detection of injection behavior from a signed Windows process like powershell.exe
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name != 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name = 'svchost.exe'

abiocs.name: Behavioral Injection Anomaly
abiocs.description: Detection of anomalous injection behavior from a signed process
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
